rules.description: Available credit is calculated by subtracting credit balance from credit limit when authorization summary exists
rules.condition: FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG is true
rules.outcome: WS-AVAILABLE-AMT is set to the difference between credit limit and current balance

rules.description: Available credit is calculated from account master when authorization summary is not found
rules.condition: FOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR is true and authorization summary not found
rules.outcome: WS-AVAILABLE-AMT is set using account credit limit minus current balance

rules.description: Approved authorization count is incremented by 1
rules.condition: AUTH-RESP-APPROVED is true
rules.outcome: PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT increased by 1

rules.description: Approved authorization amount is accumulated
rules.condition: AUTH-RESP-APPROVED is true
rules.outcome: WS-APPROVED-AMT is added to PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT

rules.description: Credit balance is updated with approved amount
rules.condition: AUTH-RESP-APPROVED is true
rules.outcome: WS-APPROVED-AMT is added to PA-CREDIT-BALANCE

rules.description: Declined authorization count is incremented by 1
rules.condition: AUTH-RESP-APPROVED is false
rules.outcome: PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT increased by 1

rules.description: Declined authorization amount is accumulated
rules.condition: AUTH-RESP-APPROVED is false
rules.outcome: PA-TRANSACTION-AMT is added to PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT

rules.description: Authorization date is computed using complement of current date
rules.condition: Always applies when creating authorization record
rules.outcome: PA-AUTH-DATE-9C is set to 99999 minus WS-YYDDD

rules.description: Authorization time is computed using complement of current time with milliseconds
rules.condition: Always applies when creating authorization record
rules.outcome: PA-AUTH-TIME-9C is set to 999999999 minus WS-TIME-WITH-MS

rules.description: Authorization date is extracted from complement representation
rules.condition: Always applies when checking expiration
rules.outcome: WS-AUTH-DATE is computed as 99999 minus PA-AUTH-DATE-9C

rules.description: Day difference is calculated between current date and authorization date
rules.condition: Always applies when checking expiration
rules.outcome: WS-DAY-DIFF is set to CURRENT-YYDDD minus WS-AUTH-DATE

rules.description: Approved authorization count is decremented when expired approved authorization is deleted
rules.condition: PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE equals 00 and authorization is expired
rules.outcome: PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT is decreased by 1

rules.description: Approved authorization amount is reduced when expired approved authorization is deleted
rules.condition: PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE equals 00 and authorization is expired
rules.outcome: PA-APPROVED-AMT is subtracted from PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT

rules.description: Declined authorization count is decremented when expired declined authorization is deleted
rules.condition: PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE is not 00 and authorization is expired
rules.outcome: PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT is decreased by 1

rules.description: Declined authorization amount is reduced when expired declined authorization is deleted
rules.condition: PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE is not 00 and authorization is expired
rules.outcome: PA-TRANSACTION-AMT is subtracted from PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT

rules.description: New transaction ID is generated by incrementing the highest existing transaction ID

rules.description: Transaction counter is incremented by 1 for each transaction read

rules.description: Monthly interest is calculated by multiplying transaction category balance by interest rate and dividing by 1200

rules.description: Account balance is reduced by the payment amount

rules.description: Transaction amount accumulation for statement total calculation
rules.condition: Processing transaction records for a card
